source_caption_text:
Being a Ye fan in 2026 has been a MOVIE 😭🔥🐐

From record-breaking stadium performances around the world to dropping new music, Ye has been giving fans plenty to celebrate this year.

His massive 2026 run included shows in front of tens of thousands of fans, with his Arlington performance drawing over 83,000 people and reportedly generating $18 MILLION in revenue. He also brought back classics like “Runaway,” “Stronger,” and “Heartless,” giving fans moments they’ll remember for years 🌎

And just when fans thought the year was winding down, Ye returned with another new single, “OUT OF MY MIND,” keeping the momentum going even after wrapping up his shows.

After all these years, Ye is still finding ways to make headlines, fill stadiums, and get people talking about his music.

2026 has really been one for the books 😮‍💨

Where does Ye’s 2026 run rank among his best eras? 👀
